cover_letter.greeting: Dear Morgan Stanley U.S. Banks FP&A Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the U.S. Banks Financial Planning & Analysis Associate role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Planning for Morgan Stanley's bank entities appeals to me because it puts forecasting right next to how a bank manages its balance sheet and capital, which is where I want to grow.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and I reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting through reconciliation work. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment.

That maps to the forecasting, variance work and reporting the team runs. I haven't worked on bank regulatory capital or stress testing yet, and I'd be ready to learn it quickly. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the U.S. Banks FP&A Associate role at Morgan Stanley.
